name: 29_open_book
title: Opening and Closing Desk Book
summary: A robotic arm opens a white book on a table, closes it, shifts it across the desk, and reopens it.
robot: one white arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a room with a wooden wall and a light grey table

segments.instruction: Lower the gripper toward the standing white book cover on the table.
Grasp the top cover edge and open the book flat onto the desk.
Press down along the open spine to flatten the pages against the table.
Grasp the top cover and fold the book shut.
segments.memory_event: hide: inside pages hidden under the closed book cover

segments.instruction: Slide the closed book toward the far right edge of the table.
Slide the book back to the center of the table.
Lift the cover to open the book once more.
segments.memory_event: return: the book interior reopens showing the identical blank white pages

segments.instruction: Release the cover and raise the arm back to the resting position.
